arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/policy_tests.py <<'PY'
import sys,copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); import gateway
from explore import B,make
D={
 'sip:alice@local.test':['sip:a@alias.test','tel:+15551234567'],
 'sip:carol@local.test':[],
 'sip:bob@other.test':['tel:+19998887777'],
 'sip:dan@other.test':[],
 'sip:eve@third.test':['sip:e@third.test'],
}
B['directory']=D
B['accounts']['u']={'primary':'sip:alice@local.test','allow':['sip:carol@local.test']}
# add peer p authority other,third; q local
B['gateways']['g']={'local_domains':['local.test'],'peers':{'p':['other.test','third.test'],'q':['local.test'],'empty':[]}}

def run(raw,ingress,trusted=True,gw='g'):
 b=copy.deepcopy(B); b['jobs']=[{'gateway':gw,'ingress':ingress,'trusted_out':trusted,'raw':raw}]
 g=gateway.process(b)['results'][0]
 return g

def show(name,g):
 print(name, '=>', (g['status'],g.get('reason') or (g['identity'],g['private'])))

L={'kind':'local','subject':'u'}
P={'kind':'peer','name':'p'}
Q={'kind':'peer','name':'q'}
U={'kind':'untrusted'}
# local
show('local from anon',run(make(frm='<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'),L))
show('local from carol',run(make(frm='<sip:carol@local.test>'),L))
show('local from bob',run(make(frm='sip:bob@other.test'),L))
show('local known ppi, from bob',run(make(frm='sip:bob@other.test',extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:carol@local.test>']),L))
show('local known ppi, from alice',run(make(frm='sip:alice@local.test',extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:carol@local.test>']),L))
show('local from anon ppi carol',run(make(frm='<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>',extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+15551234567>']),L))
show('local ignored PAI unknown',run(make(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:nobody@x.test>']),L))
show('local unknown subject',run(make(),{'kind':'local','subject':'nope'}))
show('local rpid unknown',run(make(extra=['Remote-Party-ID: <sip:nobody@x.test>']),L))
# peer common headers
def peerraw(pai,fromv='<sip:bob@other.test>',ppi=None,rpid=None):
 extra=[]
 if pai is not None: extra += ['P-Asserted-Identity: '+pai]
 if ppi is not None: extra += ['P-Preferred-Identity: '+ppi]
 if rpid is not None: extra += ['Remote-Party-ID: '+rpid]
 return make(frm=fromv,extra=extra)
show('peer normal sip',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>'),P))
show('peer normal tel alias',run(peerraw('<tel:+19998887777>'),P))
show('peer two same',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>, <tel:+19998887777>'),P))
show('peer two same reverse',run(peerraw('<tel:+19998887777>, <sip:bob@other.test>'),P))
show('peer two sip',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>, <sip:bob@other.test>'),P))
show('peer mismatch PAI',run(peerraw('<sip:alice@local.test>'),P))
show('peer PAI unauth domain',run(peerraw('<sip:eve@third.test>'),P))
show('peer from mismatch',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>',fromv='<sip:dan@other.test>'),P))
show('peer from anon',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>',fromv='<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'),P))
show('peer ppi mismatch',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>','<sip:bob@other.test>',ppi='<sip:dan@other.test>'),P))
show('peer rpid mismatch',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>','<sip:bob@other.test>',rpid='<sip:dan@other.test>'),P))
show('peer ppi match',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>','<sip:bob@other.test>',ppi='<tel:+19998887777>'),P))
show('peer no PAI',run(peerraw(None),P))
show('peer unknown',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>'),{'kind':'peer','name':'zzz'}))
show('peer listed empty authority',run(peerraw('<sip:bob@other.test>'),{'kind':'peer','name':'empty'}))
show('peer q local identity',run(peerraw('<sip:alice@local.test>'),Q))
show('untrusted valid',run(make(),U))
PY
cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/tmp python3 tmp/policy_tests.py
